summary: DeFi Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an Exhibit 99.1 press release dated November 5, 2026, announcing that its subsidiary Valour launched eight new SEK-denominated digital asset ETPs on Sweden's Spotlight Stock Market, which began trading that same day. Products track Venice (VVV), Canton Network (CC), Raydium (RAY), Morpho (MORPHO), Maple Finance (SYRUP), Pump.fun (PUMP), Dogwifhat (WIF), and Bonk (BONK). Each carries a 1.9% management fee. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. This is an ordinary product-launch current report, not a special situation; watch only for AUM growth disclosure.
